remarks: On the market for the first time EVER, 95 Louise's Lane represents the epitome of quiet sophistication and tranquility. With expansive pond and river views, this modern oasis is located at the end of a quiet cul de sac just minutes from the hustle and bustle of downtown New Canaan. Completely reimagined and tastefully designed with stark white floors and walls punctuated by spans of windows, this home boasts 5 spacious bedrooms, all with views of nature. An open and bright first floor layout invites easy entertaining while the second floor great room with loft sets the scene for classic movie nights or epic sleepovers. Outside enjoy the sprawling bluestone terrace and take a swim in your cutting-edge modpool in complete privacy. 95 Louise's Lane represents an exceptional opportunity for the truly discerning buyer
